result:
I've done both parts of the reviewer's closure criterion for F-DG3-100. Lint and the scan now refuse G1, G2 and A1, and ADR-0024 §6 no longer makes absolute claims. Every check in the assignment ran and passed, all changes are uncommitted on `dg3/kbe-h`, and no engine source changed. F-DG3-100 stays open until the reviewer verifies it.

**(a) Static refusals** (lint, mirrored in the scan, on every file of the engine's import closure):
- generator functions and `yield`;
- the names `then`, `catch` and `finally` in any position (member, key, string or computed key, destructured name, template). The `try`/`catch`/`finally` statement keywords stay allowed;
- `fromAsync` and `asyncIterator`.

The scan also refuses a `catch` or `finally` word that isn't part of a `try` statement. The engine and decimal.js use none of these outside comments. G1, G2, A1 and A2 are in the scan's probe table, built from the reviewer's own probe text. A new test lints them with ESLint and requires a rule to fire for each one. Deliberately breaking the new rules makes these tests fail (2 failures and 7 failures), so they do detect the forms.

**F1:** I fixed the scan's `finally` matcher and also replaced the "stricter" sentence. The matcher now skips strings, templates and regex literals, and reports a hit if a file's braces don't balance. Regex-literal detection is a heuristic, so ESLint remains the reference, and §6 says so.

**(b) §6:** the three named absolute sentences are gone. §6 now lists exactly what lint and the scan refuse, as seven forms L1–L7. It states the residual in the reviewer's wording, with G1, G2 and A1 as historical examples that are now refused statically. I re-read every sentence of §6 and narrowed the other overclaims ("Guarantee…", "cannot occur in production", "cannot disappear silently", and four "never/ever" sentences in the domain part). Item 28 is added to `p3-work-split.md` §9.

**Proof:** copies of the reviewer's five probes (hashes identical) ran in a disposable clone on Node 22.

| Forms | Round 5 | Now |
|---|---|---|
| G1, G2, A1 | passed all three layers | refused by lint + scan |
| F1 | lint only | lint + scan |
| G3, A2 | run-time only | also lint + scan |
| E1/E2, H1–H4, S1/S2, F2, W1–W6, V1/V2, round-3 S1–S3, the 18 bypass forms | refused | refused by the same layers as before |

**Checks** (all exit 0):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, formula `eslint` | clean |
| `pnpm test`, Node 24 and 22, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` (4 runs) | 1651 + 256 passed, 2 skipped, every run |
| Integration (Postgres on port 23100) | 793 passed, same as baseline |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2`, start and end | PASS |

The unit counts rise from 1614 + 220 / 1 skipped by exactly the new tests: 36 probe rows in both projects, plus the new ESLint test, which is skipped in the no-codegen project.

**Things that went differently:**
- **Clone dependencies:** `pnpm install --offline` couldn't run in the clone because the pnpm store is read-only here. I copied the worktree's installed `node_modules` instead (same lockfile), not a fresh install.
- **Clone commit:** the commit needed `commit.gpgsign=false` because of the global signing config. That applies in the clone only.
- **Overwritten log:** my first grep log was garbled by a shell mistake. I regenerated it with a standalone script and say so in the handback.

**What remains open:**
- **Residual:** the residual in §6 is real. A self-handling form outside L1–L7 is still refused by no layer. It is stated, not closed, which the reviewer's criterion allows.
- **Absolutes kept:** I left three absolute domain sentences in §6 (division by zero is "never 0 or Infinity", `too_long` is "never through the API", and the 2000-character count "cannot admit an invalid formula"), because the code enforces them. The handback offers to narrow them if the reviewer disagrees.

The handback quotes the final §6 text in full and names the code or test behind each sentence. Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/`:
- `T-DG3-KBE-H-kpi-benefits-engineer.md`
- `T-DG3-KBE-H-evidence/` (logs, scripts, probe copies, `changes.diff`)
